Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO₂), metabolic acidosis (low arterial pH), mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, and elevated basophils and monocytes. Albumin is slightly elevated. These findings may indicate acute or chronic hypoxic and inflammatory processes, possible bone marrow suppression, and require urgent clinical correlation and further investigation.
